items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We know George W. Bush didn’t have no jazz in his iPod.

ctx.x: When we see now that we have somebody that you know personally, how does this impact your views, your perspective on the leadership and the direction of this country?

First of all, I don’t know Barack Obama – President Barack Obama – personally. I know him, but I don’t know him personally. But I know enough about him to know that he expected more cooperation. He went into this thing thinking about everybody just waiting an opportunity for a guy to say, “Let’s make this country better.” He was thinking that if not a majority of politicians, surely the country would rise up and say, “How do we make the country better? Show us the way. We’ll pressure the politicians who are…

Okay. The game of politics. That’s the way it’s played. We got to get our boy in. I don’t care if he’s black, purple, green. We got to get our boy in. Just what happens if you’re black? Does that have anything to do with it? Oh no, oh no. But we got to get our boy in. Where are the American citizens? If all these people saying these terrible things that are tearing our country down, then surely there would be – say a million of them are saying. There’s 299 million – let’s take the kids away – there’s 200 million…
